identificationModule.briefTitle: Peptide-specific Vaccination in HLA-A*02 Positive Patients With Biochemical Recurrence After Radical Prostatectomy
identificationModule.officialTitle: Prospective Randomized Trial of Peptide-specific Vaccination in HLA-A*02 Positive Prostate Carcinoma Patients With Biochemical Recurrence After Radical Prostatectomy

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The study evaluates the prostate-specific antigen (PSA) response in HLA-A\*02 positive patients with biochemical recurrence after radical prostatectomy treated with a prostate-specific peptide vaccine in combination with different immune-adjuvants.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: Patients with a biochemical recurrence after initial therapy can be included.

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* biochemical recurrence after Radical Prostatectomy
* no clinical metastases in CT or bone scan
* HLA-Type: HLA-A\*02 positive
* Karnofsky-Performance-Index \>70
* Age \>45 / \<80 years
* no prior or ongoing hormonal therapy
* no ongoing radiation therapy
* Serum-Creatinine \<2mg/dl; Bilirubin: \<2gm/dl
* no history of allergy or chronic obstructive lung disease (COLD)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients unable to consent
* Karnofsky-Performance-Index \<70
* known allergy or COLD
* presence of secondary malignancy
* prior or ongoing hormonal treatment
* ongoing radiotherapy
* immunosuppressive medication
* seizure
